description: Removes markets from one of the signed-in member's watchlists (its id from watchlists_list). Name each one as watchlists_list shows it (source:TICKER) or by its bare symbol ("AAPL", "BTCUSD"), which removes every row of that symbol. The list itself stays; this server cannot delete a watchlist. Returns what was removed and what was not found. It changes the member's account, so the chat app may ask the user to confirm first. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

symbols.description: Markets to remove: "binance:BTCUSDT", or a bare symbol such as "AAPL".
